rules.COMMIT: compact text <= 512 KiB, strict secret scan clean and broad-keyword hits triaged, work merged into integration or on kg/rebuild-phase-map / kg/rebuild-value-gap; transcripts <= 512 KiB are included (the only stated size threshold)
rules.SKIP: COMMIT candidate already tracked on integration at the same path with identical content, or an identical duplicate from another source
rules.MANIFEST: > 512 KiB, binary, verifier source copies (scratch/, source-scratch/, merge-audit integration-collection and ancestor/branch/integration file copies, *.reconstructed.txt), mutation or superseded copies (*.original*, *.stale), symlinks
rules.DEFER: evidence for in-progress work: 1.4 env, 1.5 adapter, 5.x BC, Phase 7, gpu-receipts/gpu-bundle
rules.EXCLUDE: failed secret-scan triage; path and reason only
rules.secret_scan: broad: api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|BEGIN (OPENSSH|RSA)|wandb_|kaggle.*key (every text file); strict credential-value patterns (private-key blocks, W&B 40-hex keys, kaggle.json, KAGGLE_KEY, gh*_/sk-/hf_/AKIA/rpa_ keys, Bearer, password=, secret/token/api_key literal assignments, ssh public keys); plus triage of high-entropy strings, Codex auth/session material, public IPs and SSH logins. Strict patterns matched nothing; broad hits were identifiers (observation tokens, wandb_run_id, 'Kaggle framework keys', prose about credentials).
rules.collisions: same repo-relative target path; compared by git blob id against kg/isaiah-gap-closure; differing content would be renamed <name>.from-<worktree>.<ext> (none found)
